units.rawText: Near the military base, on the highway leading to the war zone.
units.displayText: Near the military base, on the highway leading to the war zone.

spans.text: Near the military base, on the highway leading to the war zone.

units.rawText: This working environment sucks!
units.displayText: This working environment sucks!

spans.text: This working environment sucks!

units.rawText: ...Don't be so loud when we're on dispatch, Hel.
units.displayText: ...Don't be so loud when we're on dispatch, Hel.

spans.text: ...Don't be so loud when we're on dispatch, Hel.

units.rawText: But I can't take it anymore! Are you saying you can?
units.displayText: But I can't take it anymore! Are you saying you can?

spans.text: But I can't take it anymore! Are you saying you can?

units.rawText: That logistics officer was just going too far! He was bossing us around and pointing us here and there from the moment he saw us!
units.displayText: That logistics officer was just going too far! He was bossing us around and pointing us here and there from the moment he saw us!

spans.text: That logistics officer was just going too far! He was bossing us around and pointing us here and there from the moment he saw us!

units.rawText: And what was that about "not as well-made as the Doll just now", "cheap goods", and so on... Then he just sent us out here on an assignment without another word!
units.displayText: And what was that about "not as well-made as the Doll just now", "cheap goods", and so on... Then he just sent us out here on an assignment without another word!

spans.text: And what was that about "not as well-made as the Doll just now", "cheap goods", and so on... Then he just sent us out here on an assignment without another word!

units.rawText: But the most important thing is—What the hell is with this tiny bike? I can't believe the two of us have to squeeze onto a small thing like this to clear out the battlefield!
units.displayText: But the most important thing is—What the hell is with this tiny bike? I can't believe the two of us have to squeeze onto a small thing like this to clear out the battlefield!

spans.text: But the most important thing is—What the hell is with this tiny bike? I can't believe the two of us have to squeeze onto a small thing like this to clear out the battlefield!

units.rawText: Calm down, Hel. Do not frighten away the wandering spirits.
units.displayText: Calm down, Hel. Do not frighten away the wandering spirits.

spans.text: Calm down, Hel. Do not frighten away the wandering spirits.

units.rawText: I can sense many of them up ahead...
units.displayText: I can sense many of them up ahead...

spans.text: I can sense many of them up ahead...

units.rawText: Tsk, tsk, tsk... Fine, fine, fine, work it is! Oh, woe is me...
units.displayText: Tsk, tsk, tsk... Fine, fine, fine, work it is! Oh, woe is me...

spans.text: Tsk, tsk, tsk... Fine, fine, fine, work it is! Oh, woe is me...

units.rawText: On the battlefield.
units.displayText: On the battlefield.

spans.text: On the battlefield.

units.rawText: An intense firefight just ended four hours ago, leaving nothing but rubble in its wake. Clotho easily hefts the gigantic coffin onto her back and gingerly steps forward.
units.displayText: An intense firefight just ended four hours ago, leaving nothing but rubble in its wake. Clotho easily hefts the gigantic coffin onto her back and gingerly steps forward.

spans.text: An intense firefight just ended four hours ago, leaving nothing but rubble in its wake. Clotho easily hefts the gigantic coffin onto her back and gingerly steps forward.

units.rawText: The black of her mortician's outfit looks a little sinister amid the smoke filling the battlefield.
units.displayText: The black of her mortician's outfit looks a little sinister amid the smoke filling the battlefield.

spans.text: The black of her mortician's outfit looks a little sinister amid the smoke filling the battlefield.

units.rawText: Well, this is our first time coming to a place like this. What a mess.
units.displayText: Well, this is our first time coming to a place like this. What a mess.

spans.text: Well, this is our first time coming to a place like this. What a mess.

units.rawText: We'd better hurry, Clotho. There are still airstrikes hitting the surrounding areas intermittently!
units.displayText: We'd better hurry, Clotho. There are still airstrikes hitting the surrounding areas intermittently!

spans.text: We'd better hurry, Clotho. There are still airstrikes hitting the surrounding areas intermittently!

units.rawText: Clotho does not answer Hel. Instead, she closes her eyes and quietly chants. A strong light seems to be leaking through her closed eyelids.
units.displayText: Clotho does not answer Hel. Instead, she closes her eyes and quietly chants. A strong light seems to be leaking through her closed eyelids.

spans.text: Clotho does not answer Hel. Instead, she closes her eyes and quietly chants. A strong light seems to be leaking through her closed eyelids.

units.rawText: I have found it...
units.displayText: I have found it...

spans.text: I have found it...

units.rawText: What is it, what is it?
units.displayText: What is it, what is it?

spans.text: What is it, what is it?

units.rawText: Lingering warmth... There is a spirit here that still bears attachment to the world...
units.displayText: Lingering warmth... There is a spirit here that still bears attachment to the world...

spans.text: Lingering warmth... There is a spirit here that still bears attachment to the world...

units.rawText: It is here.
units.displayText: It is here.

spans.text: It is here.

units.rawText: The sound of breathing is faintly audible through a pile of rubble from a collapsed wall.
units.displayText: The sound of breathing is faintly audible through a pile of rubble from a collapsed wall.

spans.text: The sound of breathing is faintly audible through a pile of rubble from a collapsed wall.

units.rawText: Clotho cautiously and swiftly gets to work, excavating the rocks. A soldier on his last legs appears before her.
units.displayText: Clotho cautiously and swiftly gets to work, excavating the rocks. A soldier on his last legs appears before her.

spans.text: Clotho cautiously and swiftly gets to work, excavating the rocks. A soldier on his last legs appears before her.

units.rawText: So... So bright...
units.displayText: So... So bright...

spans.text: So... So bright...

units.rawText: Am I... saved...?
units.displayText: Am I... saved...?

spans.text: Am I... saved...?

units.rawText: We are here to guide your soul.
units.displayText: We are here to guide your soul.

spans.text: We are here to guide your soul.

units.rawText: The soldier shifts his nearly-immobilized neck, his eyes filled with the fires of hope. However, when he sees Clotho, the light of hope turns to fear.
units.displayText: The soldier shifts his nearly-immobilized neck, his eyes filled with the fires of hope. However, when he sees Clotho, the light of hope turns to fear.

spans.text: The soldier shifts his nearly-immobilized neck, his eyes filled with the fires of hope. However, when he sees Clotho, the light of hope turns to fear.

units.rawText: What are you trying to do... you pile of scrap...!
units.displayText: What are you trying to do... you pile of scrap...!

spans.text: What are you trying to do... you pile of scrap...!

units.rawText: The wanderer is still on the shores of the Styx.
units.displayText: The wanderer is still on the shores of the Styx.

spans.text: The wanderer is still on the shores of the Styx.

units.rawText: What the hell are you saying... Get lost...!
units.displayText: What the hell are you saying... Get lost...!

spans.text: What the hell are you saying... Get lost...!

units.rawText: Please, lie within. I will return you to the land of the living.
units.displayText: Please, lie within. I will return you to the land of the living.

spans.text: Please, lie within. I will return you to the land of the living.

units.rawText: Clotho indicates to Hel, whose lid automatically opens.
units.displayText: Clotho indicates to Hel, whose lid automatically opens.

spans.text: Clotho indicates to Hel, whose lid automatically opens.

units.rawText: You, you want to put me in a coffin...!?
units.displayText: You, you want to put me in a coffin...!?

spans.text: You, you want to put me in a coffin...!?

units.rawText: I'm alive... I'm not dead... You goddamn A-Doll...! Are you blind or something...!
units.displayText: I'm alive... I'm not dead... You goddamn A-Doll...! Are you blind or something...!

spans.text: I'm alive... I'm not dead... You goddamn A-Doll...! Are you blind or something...!

units.rawText: The guidance was not in error. I understand that you are among the living. Please, do not be afraid.
units.displayText: The guidance was not in error. I understand that you are among the living. Please, do not be afraid.

spans.text: The guidance was not in error. I understand that you are among the living. Please, do not be afraid.

units.rawText: Clotho explains herself in earnest, but the soldier seems to be confused.
units.displayText: Clotho explains herself in earnest, but the soldier seems to be confused.

spans.text: Clotho explains herself in earnest, but the soldier seems to be confused.

units.rawText: I'm going to die... My spine's starting to hurt... But even if I'm going to die, I don't want to die down here...
units.displayText: I'm going to die... My spine's starting to hurt... But even if I'm going to die, I don't want to die down here...

spans.text: I'm going to die... My spine's starting to hurt... But even if I'm going to die, I don't want to die down here...

units.rawText: Please do not relinquish your grip upon this world...
units.displayText: Please do not relinquish your grip upon this world...

spans.text: Please do not relinquish your grip upon this world...

units.rawText: My spine... My legs... I know I'm screwed. There's no way I'm making it through this...
units.displayText: My spine... My legs... I know I'm screwed. There's no way I'm making it through this...

spans.text: My spine... My legs... I know I'm screwed. There's no way I'm making it through this...

units.rawText: Daniel's gone, and so is Sergei... We're all going to buy the farm here, I knew it from the start...
units.displayText: Daniel's gone, and so is Sergei... We're all going to buy the farm here, I knew it from the start...

spans.text: Daniel's gone, and so is Sergei... We're all going to buy the farm here, I knew it from the start...

units.rawText: Clotho doesn't speak. All she does is approach the soldier as slowly as possible while clearing away the debris around him.
units.displayText: Clotho doesn't speak. All she does is approach the soldier as slowly as possible while clearing away the debris around him.

spans.text: Clotho doesn't speak. All she does is approach the soldier as slowly as possible while clearing away the debris around him.

units.rawText: The coffin's side touches the soldier's extended left hand. His eyes glaze over and his fingers unconsciously scratch at the coffin.
units.displayText: The coffin's side touches the soldier's extended left hand. His eyes glaze over and his fingers unconsciously scratch at the coffin.

spans.text: The coffin's side touches the soldier's extended left hand. His eyes glaze over and his fingers unconsciously scratch at the coffin.

units.rawText: Guh... It's kinda ticklish...
units.displayText: Guh... It's kinda ticklish...

spans.text: Guh... It's kinda ticklish...

units.rawText: Clotho immediately pats Hel, indicating that she should be quiet.
units.displayText: Clotho immediately pats Hel, indicating that she should be quiet.

spans.text: Clotho immediately pats Hel, indicating that she should be quiet.

units.rawText: So cold... Hahh... It's the smell of metal...
units.displayText: So cold... Hahh... It's the smell of metal...

spans.text: So cold... Hahh... It's the smell of metal...

units.rawText: My grandpa was a blacksmith... When I was young, I'd watch him work every day...
units.displayText: My grandpa was a blacksmith... When I was young, I'd watch him work every day...

spans.text: My grandpa was a blacksmith... When I was young, I'd watch him work every day...

units.rawText: That was when I met Sophia... It was a spring evening; we were both young and I hadn't been conscripted for national service yet...
units.displayText: That was when I met Sophia... It was a spring evening; we were both young and I hadn't been conscripted for national service yet...

spans.text: That was when I met Sophia... It was a spring evening; we were both young and I hadn't been conscripted for national service yet...

units.rawText: I got married... And then I was conscripted... Sophia made boots and a jacket for me...
units.displayText: I got married... And then I was conscripted... Sophia made boots and a jacket for me...

spans.text: I got married... And then I was conscripted... Sophia made boots and a jacket for me...

units.rawText: I need to show you my boots... My boots... Where did my legs go... That's right, that shell hit me and...
units.displayText: I need to show you my boots... My boots... Where did my legs go... That's right, that shell hit me and...

spans.text: I need to show you my boots... My boots... Where did my legs go... That's right, that shell hit me and...

units.rawText: Sophia... How will you raise Tatiana... She's only three years old...
units.displayText: Sophia... How will you raise Tatiana... She's only three years old...

spans.text: Sophia... How will you raise Tatiana... She's only three years old...

units.rawText: The injured soldier's voice gradually trails off. He reaches out to Clotho, grabbing wildly as if in search of hope.
units.displayText: The injured soldier's voice gradually trails off. He reaches out to Clotho, grabbing wildly as if in search of hope.

spans.text: The injured soldier's voice gradually trails off. He reaches out to Clotho, grabbing wildly as if in search of hope.

units.rawText: Sophia... Tatiana...
units.displayText: Sophia... Tatiana...

spans.text: Sophia... Tatiana...

units.rawText: <size=28>We need to hurry, Clotho! The next round of airstrikes is coming!</size>
units.displayText: We need to hurry, Clotho! The next round of airstrikes is coming!

spans.text: We need to hurry, Clotho! The next round of airstrikes is coming!

units.rawText: Before the wounded soldier's hand can fall, Clotho grabs it.
units.displayText: Before the wounded soldier's hand can fall, Clotho grabs it.

spans.text: Before the wounded soldier's hand can fall, Clotho grabs it.

units.rawText: <size=28>Clotho!</size>
units.displayText: Clotho!

spans.text: Clotho!

units.rawText: <size=28>His soul needs guidance...</size>
units.displayText: His soul needs guidance...

spans.text: His soul needs guidance...

units.rawText: I don't want to die... I want to go home...
units.displayText: I don't want to die... I want to go home...

spans.text: I don't want to die... I want to go home...

units.rawText: I don't want to die... Mama... Save me... Mama...
units.displayText: I don't want to die... Mama... Save me... Mama...

spans.text: I don't want to die... Mama... Save me... Mama...

units.rawText: <size=28>It's coming! Clotho!</size>
units.displayText: It's coming! Clotho!

spans.text: It's coming! Clotho!

units.rawText: A whistling sound comes from overhead. Hel turns and forms an angle against the broken wall to shelter Clotho and the injured soldier under her as best as she can manage.
units.displayText: A whistling sound comes from overhead. Hel turns and forms an angle against the broken wall to shelter Clotho and the injured soldier under her as best as she can manage.

spans.text: A whistling sound comes from overhead. Hel turns and forms an angle against the broken wall to shelter Clotho and the injured soldier under her as best as she can manage.

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: Ahhhhh—
units.displayText: Ahhhhh—

spans.text: Ahhhhh—

units.rawText: The earth trembles and the sky burns.
units.displayText: The earth trembles and the sky burns.

spans.text: The earth trembles and the sky burns.

units.rawText: And the wounded soldier's weeping gradually stops.
units.displayText: And the wounded soldier's weeping gradually stops.

spans.text: And the wounded soldier's weeping gradually stops.
